conservation.help_by: Keep nesting beaches dark and clear; support marine protected areas.
conservation.caution_against: Never buy turtle products; don’t block crawlways or touch nesting turtles.

life_info.eating: The pasture of the coastal sea. Makes energy from sunlight (and sometimes from clear shallow water light).
life_info.mating: Spreads by spores, seeds, propagules, or creeping rhizomes depending on the species.
life_info.habitat: Sandy shallows forming wide underwater meadows. Forms habitat structure that shelters fish, crabs, and invertebrates.

fun_facts: Named because green turtles mow it like a salad bar.
Seagrass beds store carbon in sediment — blue-carbon heroes.
